title: Western Sydney International Airport opens to passengers today
paragraphs: Passengers will fly on the first commercial flight from Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) to the Gold Coast today.
Located 45 kilometres from Sydney's CBD, WSI in Badgerys Creek is open 24/7.
WSI's CEO Simon Hickey says the airport has been designed for growth, and that in the 2060s it could reach its full 82 million passenger capacity per year.
